spells.targets: Choose one mode: one discrete unattended, unsecured object you perceive, no larger than Small and no heavier than 10 pounds; or up to 10 pounds of existing loose nonmagical sand or dust contained within one 5-foot square. spells.resolution: Automatic for an eligible object or selected loose material; no attack or save.
spells.effect: Object mode pushes the object up to 5 feet directly away from you. Dust/sand mode scatters the selected loose material up to 5 feet away from you. Stop movement before solid terrain or illegal occupancy; ordinary loose material may settle on an accessible supporting surface.
spells.limitations: Worn, held, attached, restrained, locked, packed, structural or otherwise secured material is ineligible. Ordinary floor, table or shelf support alone is not security. The spell creates no material and grants no excavation, blindness, damage, disarm, collision damage or generated resource. Ordinary physical consequences, such as exposing a surface or removing support and beginning Falling, still follow. Moving some dust does not automatically erase tracks, remove a hazard or neutralize its independent effect.
